load_and_preprocess_data: load and preprocess computational and experimental electrocatalysis data with XRD matching and fixed potential interpolation
get_and_apply_xrf_mapping: build a mapping from XRF composition data and apply it to an experimental dataframe
get_production_rate: compute the production rate in mol per cm squared second from faradaic efficiency and current density
get_constant_V: interpolate experimental CO2R data to a fixed applied potential using log-linear interpolation
add_cv_categories: add leave-one-out and leave-one-composition-out cross-validation columns to a dataframe for ML training
